title: Backscatter Pedestrian
text: Backscatter signals from pedestrian, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Height (m)} sets the height of pedestrian, {Walking Speed (m/s)} sets the walking speed of pedestrian 1.4 times pedestrian, {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Operating Frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency 300e6, {Initial Position (m)} sets the initial position of pedestrian, {Initial Heading (deg)} sets the initial heading of pedestrian and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Incident radar signals complex-valued M -by-16 matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Combined reflected radar signals complex-valued M -by-1 column vector

ports.name: Pos
ports.summary: Positions of body segments real-valued 3-by-16 matrix

ports.name: Vel
ports.summary: Velocity of body segments real-valued 3-by-16 matrix

ports.name: Ax
ports.summary: Orientation of body segments real-valued 3-by-3-by-16 array

params.name: Walking Speed (m/s)
params.values: Walking speed of pedestrian 1.4 times pedestrian height (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial Position (m)
params.values: Initial position of pedestrian [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by-1 real-valued vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
